title: Verify: Zero-quota gating unit tests
description: Prove submit is blocked at 0 remaining and allowed at 1 remaining, using a mocked history response.
acceptance_criteria: 5 sent entries disable Send and show the message
technical_constraints: History fixture built from contributionFixture in tests/fixtures/api.ts, matching the listMine response (Contribution[] from GET player/me/contributions in src/api/client.ts)

steps.action: Stub fetch so the listMine route returns 5 contributions derived from contributionFixture with distinct prompts; render with roundId 'ROUND-1'; await findByText('No contributions left this round'); assert Send and textarea are disabled and no POST was made.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/contributionValidation.test.tsx -t 'zero quota'
steps.expected: Message shown, controls disabled, no POST

steps.action: Stub listMine with 4 contributions; type 'idea' and assert Send is enabled and queryByText('No contributions left this round') is null.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/contributionValidation.test.tsx -t 'one left'
